ESTIMATE: with January-July 2026 revenue +37.0% YoY and company guidance of slightly above +40% growth in USD, FY2026 revenue lands near US$170B. At a 47% net margin — modestly above FY2025's 44.6%, consistent with the three-year trend — FY2026 net income is roughly US$80B, or about US$15.42 per ADS.
